SECOND image only supports its blue laser weapon, not the base model. Preserve first reference aircraft proportions and detailed angular silhouette; no cartoon face, limbs or humanoid pilot. Premium crisp hand-painted 2D fighting-game sprites at least as refined as the reference. Every cell aircraft faces RIGHT, complete wings/nose/tail inside cell, wide transparent gutters, consistent physical size; same full three-quarter SIDE perspective so silhouette reads horizontally. Frames row-major: 0 neutral level hover with engine off, 1 gentle forward low hover bank, 2 level hovering opposite bank, 3 slow controlled braking nose slightly high; 4 compressed low altitude crouch with wing tips leveled, 5 boost anticipation rear engines barely lit, 6 acceleration nose low, 7 fast level flight engines lit, 8 hard bank and decelerate, 9 turning show slightly more underside while still facing right, 10 takeoff nose up 20 degrees, 11 ascending 35 degrees, 12 airborne level with wings out, 13 second air boost nose up 10 degrees, 14 descending nose down 15 degrees, 15 landing flare nose level. Dramatic detailed three-quarter close view facing right, camera near the cockpit and leading wing shoulders, nose/cockpit dominant and large with both inner wing roots visible. Frame like a face-and-shoulders portrait of a non-humanoid aircraft, comfortable safe margins, beautiful cool blue rim light, finely painted Japanese game illustration. Transparent background, no sky, no clouds, no symbols, no logos, text, humans, border or watermark. This must be a separately drawn crisp selection portrait, not a crop of a sprite or of the sheet.
